message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "prioritize_visual_inspection_over_classifier_for_interval_changes", "description": "When automated classifiers return non-specific or low-confidence scores in multi-image comparison tasks, bypass tool outputs for interval analysis and perform direct visual inspection to identify subtle spatiotemporal changes.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving the comparison of multiple chest X-rays (e.g., baseline vs. follow-up) where automated tools provide ambiguous, low-confidence, or non-specific classification results regarding disease progression or resolution.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": [], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns non-specific labels or low-confidence scores when comparing serial images: (1) Do NOT rely on the tool's output for determining interval changes or severity progression; (2) Perform direct visual inspection of the original images side-by-side; (3) Specifically look for subtle spatiotemporal patterns (e.g., migratory consolidation, changing opacity density) that automated tools fail to quantify or chronologically link."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
